svg.title: Give your agents 961 licence-clean skills
svg.desc: $ uv pip install dex-trove $ ananke registry init $ ananke registry learn python:dex-trove $ ananke registry search motion $ ananke registry show neo-pragnya/interactive-web-motion $ ananke registry resolve neo-pragnya/interactive-web-motion --explain
svg.text: Install Dex Trove, learn it into the Ananke registry, find a skill and see why the resolver picked it.
